findings.summary: Regression tests duplicate assertions already added to the median describe block.
findings.suggested_fix: Consolidate the duplicated median([1,2,3,4]) === 2.5 / median([4,1,3,2]) === 2.5 assertions into a single block, and add a genuinely distinct case (e.g. even-length with negatives like median([-2,0,2,4]) === 1).
